subject: Onboarding bridge credit approval — BlueHarbor Labs / accelerator promo
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@blueharbor.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accelerator onboarding credits + short extension

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by Redwood's latency and the routing options. We're finalizing our accelerator package and have two quick asks before we sign the MSA: 1) can Redwood provide a short-term onboarding credit to bridge us for the first 60 days while we complete integration work, and 2) if needed, extend the free trial window for our pilot from 30 to 60 days?

We expect to consume roughly ~20M tokens in the first month while we run internal tests and a small public beta. If there's a standard accelerator promo code or an onboarding voucher process, please point me to the right contacts.

I've attached a short scope doc (BlueHarbor_Scope_v1.pdf) that maps the pilot milestones. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Park
Founder & Head of Partnerships
BlueHarbor Labs

Attachment: BlueHarbor_Scope_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator onboarding credits + short extension

Hi Elena — great to hear the demo resonated. Thanks for sending the scope.

Short answers up front: we can usually support an onboarding credit + a one-time trial extension for accelerator partners, but it is typically milestone-conditional (milestone signoff -> tranche release). To move quickly I need to confirm:
- Exact credit amount you want (dollars or token estimate)
- Whether you need the credits up front or prefer staged release tied to the milestones in your attached scope
- Any procurement/legal contacts (we may need a signed SOW for larger credits)

From experience, a common structure is $25k in credits (applied as a promo voucher) with incremental release: 40% on integration complete, 40% on beta launch, 20% on GA. If that looks reasonable we can draft a short SOW and route for DocuSign.

Looping in Lauren (program ops) and Marcus (commercial) to confirm the approval path and any finance/escrow needs.

—Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_summary.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: accelerator onboarding credits + short extension

Thanks Priyom. Quick notes from Program Ops:

- We can approve milestone-based credits for accelerators up to $30k without exec sign-off if the partner agrees to milestone definitions and reporting cadence.
- We require simple milestone acceptance evidence (email confirmation + an artifacts link) before each tranche.
- 60-day trial extension is fine for this pilot, but we'll cap per-model concurrency to protect host pools (I will include concurrency caps in the SOW).

If BlueHarbor is comfortable with staged release, I can draft the SOW language today and share for a fast signature. Also recommend a 60-day usage reporting checkpoint at day 30 to ensure they aren't hitting unexpected unit economics.

—Lauren
Partnerships Program Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: accelerator onboarding credits + short extension

Elena — glad to be on this thread. Commercial terms I'd propose:

- Promo credit: $25,000 applied to account as voucher code REDWOOD-ACC-25K-DH8921
- Trial extension: 60 days from voucher activation (voucher valid for 90 days)
- Release schedule: 40% ($10k) on integration sign-off, 40% ($10k) on beta launch, 20% ($5k) on GA acceptance
- We need a signed SOW for bookkeeping; minor redlines ok but procurement must approve SOW amount
- If the partner wants the full $25k upfront we can do so but require the SOW + an expense approval ticket (typical for >$20k)

Priyom — if you confirm acceptance, I can create the HubSpot deal task and generate the DocuSign SOW link. Lauren, please add the concurrency cap language (two simultaneous model endpoints) and the 30-day usage checkpoint.

—Marcus
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator onboarding credits + short extension

Thanks all — this looks good. We accept the staged release schedule and the $25k voucher. A couple of quick asks before you draft the SOW:

1) Can the first tranche ($10k) be released on a lightweight integration checklist (I've attached the minimal checklist to speed things up)?
2) For compliance, we need an attestation that audit logs and request-level metadata will be retained for 90 days — is that covered under Redwood's standard offering?

We are happy to sign the SOW; please send the DocuSign link and we'll route internally. Also please confirm the voucher code string so our finance team can allocate it in our pilot budget.

Elena Park
Founder & Head of Partnerships
BlueHarbor Labs
